status: CANCELLED BY EXP-0040 SEARCH_ONLY; no dataset or fit run; implementation removed from new-model 2026-10-25, preserved on archive-1 (7aeef1f)
question: Can a pooled regularized relational MPNN learn producer preferences that transfer to independent trajectory seeds within the same three topologies, then improve closed-loop delivery as a bounded confidence-gated residual over blend_0.5?
scope: Within-topology trajectory generalization only; no unseen-topology claim.

dependency.mean_target_licensed: continuation_mean with smallest K in {4,8,16} licensed by EXP-0040

training.loss: task-balanced decision-weighted MSE on decision-centered primary labels
training.task_weighting_note: each task's TOTAL gradient weight per epoch is equalized (weight 1/(its batch count)), not just its share of each batch: the tail batches of an epoch belong to the largest task alone. Registered topologies differ 1.43x in decisions, which under per-batch-only balance was a 2.16x epoch gradient-weight skew.

adapter.formula: blend_0.5_logits + alpha * clip(center(ensemble_scores), -1, 1) when unanimous and margin-qualified; otherwise blend_0.5

offline_gate_a: regret >=10% below random on >=2/3 test tasks
regret beats fair held-out row MLP on >=2/3 test tasks
no task >5% worse than row MLP
r2/random conditions hold for ensemble mean and each model seed
closed_loop_gate_b: consumer units beat blend_0.5 on >=2/3 test tasks
no individual episode >10% worse than paired blend
eligibility, conservation, finiteness, and soft multi-producer routing hold

implementation.split_registry: graph_generalization_dump.SPLIT_REGISTRY + validate_split_registry (disjoint, whole-episode, nested 2/4/8 prefixes, rejects reuse of the EXP-0037..0040 anchor seeds {29,30,31}/{77,78,79}/{45,46,47})
implementation.target_modes: target_mode is a REQUIRED argument with no default; single_suffix is byte-identical to the EXP-0039 label (parity-tested); continuation_mean averages K EXP-0040 forks and persists every raw continuation label plus the original-suffix control
implementation.exp0040_license: TargetLicense + read_exp0040_license(<EXP-0040 result>): the classification picks the (mode, K) pair, AMBIGUOUS raises Exp0040Blocked, SEARCH_ONLY raises Exp0040Cancelled, and continuation_mean must take the SMALLEST converged K in {4,8,16}. The artifact must stamp experiment=EXP-0040 and carry its own convergence_by_k evidence: K is DERIVED from that map, there is deliberately no --continuations flag to override it, and a converged_continuations field contradicting the map raises. run_generalization_dump refuses to spend label compute without a license (require_license, smoke-only escape); the dump CLI requires --exp0040-result and verifies pinned inputs + a 40-char source commit by default
implementation.dump_certification: certify_dump_contract(): experiment id, frozen delta/lookahead/horizon/floor/schema hash, exactly the three registered tasks, the exact split registry AND collected seed set per (task, split), pinned archive/producer SHA-256, whole-tree source fingerprint + commit, and the declared row counts. The license must name a real EXP-0040 file with a 64-char SHA-256 (an inline classification is a claim, not a license) and its K is RE-DERIVED from the recorded convergence evidence rather than read from the recorded number. Every real stage runs it (require_shape=True by default)
implementation.fit_certification: certify_fit_contract() / certify_fit_spec(): require_shape certifies the dataset, this certifies the RUN — exactly the registered arms (plus the auto-added mean-mode control), model seeds (0,1,2), train-8, the 2/4/8 curve, an unmodified training recipe (no shortened --max-epochs), and a 40-char commit. Checked BEFORE training compute is spent and re-checked from the written spec by both rollout stages, so a one-seed one-epoch fit cannot be stamped certified and license a rollout
implementation.cross_stage_source: fit, gate-a and both rollout stages call EXP-0039's assert_source_matches/assert_env_matches against the dump's recorded source + env, so a dump built by one tree/runtime cannot be fitted, scored, or deployed under another
implementation.rollout_certification: assert_rollout_shape(): the validation/test rollouts must use exactly the registered tasks, that split's registered episode seeds, the dump's horizon, the REGISTERED model seeds (0,1,2), a fit that itself satisfies the fit contract, the same code and runtime, and the same archive + producer checkpoint by SHA-256
implementation.fair_row_baseline: candidates.csv carries the 7 deployable actor row features so row_mlp_h32 retrains on the identical splits/target (EXP-0039's actor floor was fitted on the trajectories it was scored on)
implementation.architecture: graph_router_probe.RelationalGNN parameterized (layers/hidden/dropout, layers=0 legal); dropout defaults to 0.0 so the EXP-0039 gate path is numerically unchanged
implementation.leakage_control: the fit stage loads splits=('train','validation') only, and an excluded decision is reduced to its identity columns BEFORE any number is parsed — a final-test label/feature/continuation row is never read at all, not merely never returned (proved by a poisoned-label test that loads fine at fit and raises on a full load)
implementation.run_order: fit -> validation adapter grid -> content-hash manifest lock (checkpoints + normalization + architecture_selection + the fit spec.json + adapter.json, keyed by root, every entry verified) -> gate-a (first test-label read; refuses without a verifying manifest; takes the arm from the LOCKED architecture_selection.json) -> gate-b (recomputes Gate A from the prediction CSV whose SHA-256 gate_a.json recorded, and binds manifest hash + arm + dump source). gate_b.json is bound to test_rows.csv the same way, and the standalone --stage verdict RECOMPUTES both gates rather than reading their pass fields
implementation.artifact_only_gates: gate_a() consumes prediction rows and gate_b() consumes rollout rows; both are recomputable from CSV with no checkpoint and no simulator. Their expected scope DEFAULTS to the registry (require_registered=True) and is never inferred from the rows on hand: exactly the registered tasks, their registered final-test episodes, and model seeds (0,1,2), with identical decision/candidate coverage per arm and model seed for Gate A, one-for-one blend pairing for Gate B, and no duplicated rows. A caller-supplied narrower scope is refused as registered_scope=False
implementation.required_controls: in continuation_mean mode run_fit automatically fits the pooled mpnn_4x64 single-suffix control on the same train-8 rows; gate-a retains final-test predictions for EVERY fitted arm; train rows are reported over the FULL train split so flat counts and flat-candidate predictions are present; train->test gaps are written by gate-a; the rollout stages emit spec.json and verdict.json
implementation.route_integrity: RouteAudit compares the decoded final routing against the base routing at the SAME state (conservation, eligibility masking, preserved multi-producer split) and is a Gate B condition
implementation.verdict: verdict_from_gates() emits exactly one of the four pre-registered result strings

layout_deviations: gate-a writes test_predictions.csv / test_metrics_by_split_task_seed.csv / gate_a.json into its OWN stage dir instead of appending to probe/predictions.csv, so the locked fit dir is never mutated by the test read
manifest.json (content-hash lock over checkpoints + normalization.json + architecture_selection.json + adapter.json) lives in the rollout/adapter dir
the future-demand fork lives in env/ (needs RNG + config legality) rather than domain/, which stays RNG-free per CLAUDE.md

staged_label_collection.rule: collect train + validation labels only; fit; select arm and adapter; freeze the manifest; ONLY THEN collect final-test labels
staged_label_collection.why_unbiased: test seeds, target mode, commit and the stop rule are all fixed in advance; staging changes WHEN the labels are paid for, not WHICH episodes are read or by what criterion
staged_label_collection.saving: 9 of 42 expensive episodes (21%) when validation fails
staged_label_collection.code_impact: certify_dump_contract currently requires spec['splits'] == all three splits and the exact collected seed set for every split; it must accept a train+validation tranche and a later test tranche, both certified against the same pre-registered registry
staged_label_collection.saving_correction: the curve does NOT avoid the label spend: train-2 and train-4 are nested PREFIXES of train-8, so the mandatory run still needs all 24 train + 9 validation episodes = ~79% of the label budget. Staged collection saves only the remaining 9 test episodes (~21%), and only when validation is not passed.
staged_label_collection.mechanism: run_generalization_dump already took `splits`; certification is what changed. certify_dump_contract(expected_splits=FIT_TRANCHE|TEST_TRANCHE) certifies a TRANCHE: it still demands the FULL pre-registered registry (test seeds included) from every tranche, so staging cannot let a later tranche choose its test seeds with the fit in hand, and it refuses a fit tranche that collected labels outside its own splits. assert_tranches_agree(fit_spec, test_spec) then proves the two directories are one experiment (frozen contract, pinned inputs, licence, target/K, registry) before Gate A scores across them; the source COMMIT is deliberately allowed to differ, since the fit happens in between and the tree may move.
staged_label_collection.stage_wiring: run_fit(dump_tranche=FIT_TRANCHE) certifies the fit tranche and records it in fit/spec.json; run_gate_a(test_dump_dir=...) reads final-test labels from the test tranche and cross-certifies. Under staging the fit CANNOT read a final-test label because it does not yet exist on disk — a stronger guarantee than the previous read-time exclusion.

rollout_only_seeds.rule: expensive LABELED seeds stay 3/task for Gate A; adapter selection and Gate B use separate, cheap, pre-registered rollout-only seed sets that need no teacher labels
rollout_only_seeds.why: nine (alpha, margin) configurations were being selected on nine validation episodes and Gate B read nine test episodes; a favourable seed could dominate. Rollout episodes cost a policy rollout, not a teacher search.
rollout_only_seeds.constraint: pre-registered, disjoint from the labeled splits AND from SPENT_SEEDS (the EXP-0037..0040 anchor set)
rollout_only_seeds.validator: validate_rollout_registry(): pre-registered, unique int seeds, correct block sizes (10/20), disjoint from EVERY labeled split of the same task — not merely the same-named one, since a Gate B rollout played on a TRAIN episode is contaminated however it is filed — disjoint between rollout validation and test, and never a seed EXP-0037..0040 spent.

arm_ladder.decision: MANDATORY = 4 arms x 3 seeds + the 2/4/8 curve; per-task arm optional
moved_to_optional_diagnostics: mpnn_4x64_per_task (opt-in post-mortem, not part of the mandatory result)
arm_ladder.rationale: neither affects the verdict; both may be run later on the train/validation artifacts if the primary result needs diagnosis
arm_ladder.measured_saving: 58.8% of fit cost (1820 s/epoch mandatory vs 4413 full); owner estimate was 40-60%

curve.status: MANDATORY (reinstated 2026-08-16 after the pilot showed pooling alone does not close the gap)
curve.fits: train-2 and train-4 are additional fits; train-8 is REUSED from the primary fit
curve.normalization: separate train-fold normalizer per size (fitted inside train_arm on that size's training graphs)

separates.rising: additional independent trajectories help, though train-8 may still be insufficient
separates.flat: increasing trajectory coverage over the tested range does not solve the problem

curve.NOT_A_GATE: diagnostic only. It does not select the architecture and does not touch the adapter, Gate A or Gate B. If train-8 fails the pre-registered validation arm-selection, stop before test labels; if train-8 passes, a flat curve may NOT cancel the test; a rising curve may NOT rescue a train-8 that failed selection.

execution_prerequisites.epoch_probe: one pooled mpnn_4x64 fit on the EXISTING EXP-0039 dump, no new labels, to measure epochs-to-early-stop. LAUNCHED on RunPod CPU pod xtyr889fxi7pml 2026-08-16. Caveat: EXP-0039 holds 3 episodes/task, so one held out for validation leaves a train-2-scale fit (2576 non-flat decisions, 27 batches/epoch) rather than train-8 (11373, 118) - fewer batches per epoch means more epochs to the same number of updates, so its epoch count is an indicative upper bound, not the train-8 number.
execution_prerequisites.sharded_fit_runner: one process per (arm, model seed), single-thread math, deterministic aggregation. Changes execution, not the scientific protocol. NOTE: it cuts core OCCUPANCY, not LATENCY - the runs are independent, so wall-clock floors at the longest single run (mpnn_4x64 at train-8 = 6.9 h at min_epochs=50, 41 h at max_epochs=300, single-thread; 13.6/81.5 h pessimistic). No core count reduces that.
execution_prerequisites.latency_lever: OPEN. Options: keep single-thread determinism and accept the 7-41 h critical path; allow multi-threading for the mandatory arms (trades bitwise fit reproducibility, needs the determinism guarantee restated in FIT_CONTRACT); or lower max_epochs. Owner: decide after the epoch probe.

protocol_v2.early_stop_patience: UNCHANGED. The pilot used the old single-suffix dataset and one model seed; tuning patience from it before the target mode is licensed would be premature. The 38 min critical path is acceptable as-is.
